title: Puzzle 5d Fill Loading Meshes Freeze
description: When starting fill in puzzle 5d, the 3d window shows "Loading meshes…" and freezes. Puzzle 3d works normally. Root cause: outer Suspense in FiveD3d deadlocks when fill mesh preload suspends. Fix by removing/moving Suspense and preloading fill catalog meshes like 3d.
summary: Fixed puzzle 5d 3d surface host crash: `sceneHostPort`, `brushMeshUrlsForFillSession`, `isLoadableMeshUrl`, `resolvePuzzle3dFixtureDrop`, and `Puzzle3dFixtureDropDetail` were only imported in the puzzle 3d host region of `framework/product/playground/renderer/react/index.tsx`. The `./puzzle/5d` subpath entry tree-shakes away that region, so `Puzzle5d3dSurfaceHost` threw `ReferenceError: sceneHostPort is not defined` on mount. Added the missing imports to the puzzle 5d adapters region. Verified: puzzle 5d play build succeeds, dev server loads 2d+3d canvases, fill tool activates without "Loading meshes…" freeze.
